about: Symbols Minn answers on purpose in its own way, not as WordPress does. Each is real code, but its output is Minn's by design, so no probe compares it with the reference; it counts as accounted for and stays out of the proven figure (tests/tools/deadends.php gives it the area 'different'). Austin decides what goes here; every entry names its reason.

functions.wp_version_check: Minn answers the core update check itself, with no request to wordpress.org: update_core holds one 'latest' offer for the WordPress release Minn speaks (Austin, 2026-10-11, D8).
functions.wp_update_plugins: Plugin updates come from the Minn update service and the plugins' own update filters, not from wordpress.org; Minn Admin calls this to refresh its offers (Austin, 2026-10-11, D8).
functions.wp_update_themes: Theme updates come from the Minn update service, not from wordpress.org; Minn Admin calls this to refresh its offers (Austin, 2026-10-11, D8).
functions._maybe_update_core: Runs Minn's own core check when the stored answer is old; the reference asks wordpress.org (Austin, 2026-10-11, D8).
functions._maybe_update_plugins: Runs Minn's own plugin check when the stored answer is old; the reference asks wordpress.org (Austin, 2026-10-11, D8).
functions._maybe_update_themes: Runs Minn's own theme check when the stored answer is old; the reference asks wordpress.org (Austin, 2026-10-11, D8).
functions.wp_cron: Minn runs due events itself, after the response and under its own lock; the reference hooks _wp_cron on shutdown to spawn a loopback, which Minn left out (Austin, 2026-10-09). spawn_cron() is the reference's loopback (Austin, 2026-10-11, D17).
functions.wp_enqueue_global_styles: Minn prints the global styles with its own writer (Theme\GlobalStyles, D3) instead of queueing a global-styles stylesheet (Austin, 2026-10-11, D17).
functions.wp_enqueue_classic_theme_styles: Minn ships none of WordPress's stylesheets, the classic theme styles among them; the engine's own block CSS covers classic themes (Austin, 2026-10-11, D17).
functions._wp_register_default_font_collections: The google-fonts collection is served from wordpress.org; Minn makes no wordpress.org requests (Track H) and its font library is an editor dead end (Austin, 2026-10-11, D17).
functions.wp_default_scripts: Minn registers its own small set of scripts; WordPress's JavaScript files (234 handles on the reference) are not part of the engine (Austin, 2026-10-11, D17).
functions.wp_default_styles: Minn registers none of WordPress's stylesheets (420 handles on the reference); the engine prints its own CSS (Austin, 2026-10-11, D17).
functions._wp_connectors_pass_default_keys_to_ai_c: Minn carries no AI provider classes (D5), so there is no provider to hand a stored key to; the connectors and their keys work as on the reference (Austin, 2026-10-11, D17).

classes.WP_Sitemaps_Stylesheet: The sitemaps' XSL stylesheet is Minn's own writing; WordPress's stylesheet text is WordPress's own work and is not carried (Austin, 2026-10-11, D11).
